title: Lost Updates in an Async Token Bucket

brief.overview: This limiter looks correct until many callers await refill at the same time. Each caller snapshots tokens, yields, then writes back — inventing or losing tokens. Serialize the critical section so Allow() is safe under concurrent async callers.
requirements: Allow() must not lose or invent tokens when many callers run concurrently via Promise.all.
An empty bucket must deny and must not go negative.
Do not busy-spin. A mutex implemented as a promise chain is enough.
hintsOrConstraints: JavaScript is single-threaded, but await still interleaves. Treat the gap between read and write as a race.
Visible tests call Allow() concurrently. If they fail, you still have a lost-update.

defenseGate.question: What did you do, and why did you do that?
defenseGate.placeholder: Explain the lost-update window and how you serialized refill + deduct.
